home.title: PhotoMesh
home.description: The gallery service foundation is ready. Library and sync features will follow in later stages.
home.desktopDescription: The Tauri 2 desktop shell is ready. Library access will use authorized APIs in a later stage.

gallery.connectDescription: Connect to a PhotoMesh node you administer. Access credentials stay in this page's memory.
gallery.credentialNote: The token stays in page memory and must be re-entered after closing or refreshing this page.
gallery.timelineDescription: Originals stay on their source nodes; this view shows the authorized index and availability.
gallery.emptyLibrary: This library has no photos yet
gallery.emptyHint: Photos appear here after an authorized node indexes them.
gallery.sourceOffline: The original source is currently unavailable.
gallery.addTag: Add a tag or create a virtual album
gallery.previewTooLarge: This file is too large to preview safely in memory. Download the original instead.
gallery.previewUnsupported: This image format cannot be decoded by this previewer.
gallery.previewUnavailable: This asset is unavailable or you are not authorized to read it.
gallery.previewFailed: Could not load this image preview.
gallery.noTaggedItemsLoaded: No tagged items in the pages loaded so far
gallery.localAlbumPageHint: Local albums filter pages already loaded on this device; load more pages to search further.
gallery.connectionFailed: Could not connect to this node.
gallery.invalidNodeAddress: Enter a valid HTTP(S) node origin without credentials, query, fragment, or path.
gallery.desktopRemoteNodeUnsupported: This desktop build connects only to a local node. Use the Web app for LAN or remote nodes.
gallery.insecureRemoteNode: Remote nodes must use HTTPS. HTTP is allowed only for a loopback node.
gallery.desktopConnectDescription: Connect to a PhotoMesh node running on this computer. Use the Web app to connect to LAN or remote nodes.
gallery.offlineSessionNotice: Node is offline. Showing authorized timeline data and cached thumbnails available in this session; originals and node actions need reconnection.
gallery.cachedPreviewNote: Showing the cached thumbnail only; the original is unavailable while this node is offline.
gallery.cacheUnavailable: The preview is available, but this browser could not save its thumbnail cache.
gallery.cacheClearFailed: Could not clear the thumbnail cache; source files and library data were not changed.
gallery.authorizationRequired: Access was denied or this session expired. Reconnect with an authorized token.
gallery.requestConflict: The node state changed while applying this request. Refresh and try again.
gallery.localMetadataSaveFailed: Could not save local tags; no node data or originals were changed.
gallery.restoreConfirm: Restore this item to the library index? Original bytes will remain unchanged.
gallery.restoreSucceeded: Item restored to the library index. Original bytes were not changed.
gallery.grantReadAccess: Grant read access to selected libraries
gallery.selectLibraryToGrant: Select a library before granting access.
gallery.approvePeerConfirm: Approve this verified device? No library access will be granted until you select libraries separately.
gallery.rejectPeerConfirm: Reject this verified device? It will not be trusted.
gallery.recycleDescription: Shows deletion tombstones from sync events. Items represent index state and never automatically delete originals on any node.
gallery.recycleSafetyText: Restoring a tombstone restores the library index only; it never changes original bytes. Permanent deletion and emptying the recycle bin are unavailable.
gallery.recycleEmpty: No active tombstones in this library
gallery.settingsDescription: Manage the current node connection, explicit pairing approvals, and this device's thumbnail cache.
gallery.nodeConnectionDescription: Change the API address or update access credentials held in this page session.
gallery.pairingDescription: Connect nodes with a short-lived QR invitation. Verify its source and Peer ID before pairing.
gallery.inviteTtl: Invitations are short-lived and can only be used once.
gallery.inviteShortLived: The QR contains a short-lived secret. Do not share it publicly.
gallery.scanInvitePlaceholder: Paste the QR code JSON here…
gallery.noTrustedNodes: No devices are paired with this node, or pairing is unavailable.
gallery.revokeConfirm: Revoke trust for this node? Existing connections will close.
gallery.localCacheDescription: Clears all regenerable thumbnails in this browser or desktop profile. It does not change the library index or source files.
gallery.clearCacheConfirm: Clear all regenerable thumbnails stored in this browser or desktop profile? The library index and source files will not be changed.
gallery.tagPrivacy: Tags and virtual albums are stored on this device per node and library; they are not synced and do not change the node index.
gallery.editorUnavailable: Media version editing is unavailable on this node.
gallery.versionCreateFailed: Could not create or process the derived version.
gallery.versionContentFailed: Could not read this derived version. The original was not substituted.
gallery.originalReadOnly: The original is read-only; edits create a separate library version.
gallery.cropControls: Normalized crop controls, values from 0 to 1
gallery.invalidCrop: Crop values must form a valid rectangle within the source image.
